description: A man in a white habit and black cloak stands on a stone step, one hand raised and the other holding an open book, speaking to a crowd. Several hooded friars in black and white stand behind him at left. The setting is a medieval town square with stone arches and half-timbered buildings, with market stalls and a crowd of townspeople in plain wool clothing. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text or border.
